title: ProAct accounting policy envelope (shared definitions)
description: Shared $defs for every `accounting_policies` document (plan 0.2 target design item 2; spec section 21 D01-D15, FND03, WF03). Each policy kind schema in this folder declares the envelope fields locally and references these definitions so scope, versioning and role vocabulary are identical across kinds. Envelope fields map 1:1 to columns of `accounting_policies`; the kind-specific `body` maps to its JSON column.

policyKind.description: Discriminator; equals `accounting_policies.policy_kind` and the `policyKind` const of the matching kind schema.

version.description: Monotonic per (tenant, site, unit, policyKind). Published versions are immutable; a change is a new version with a new effectiveFrom. Every calculation run records the versions it used (FND03, WF03).

effectiveFrom.description: UTC instant from which this version applies (half-open interval [effectiveFrom, effectiveTo)).

effectiveTo.description: UTC instant at which this version stops applying; null = open-ended (current version).

scope.description: Where the policy applies. Resolution order at run time: unit > site > tenant (most specific effective version wins). tenantId is mandatory; seeds carry the all-zero placeholder which the seeder replaces with the real tenant id.

notes.description: Free-text rationale or seeding notes. Never interpreted by any engine.

legacyRole.description: Role names of the v1 `users.role` column (see `src/auth/decorators/roles.decorator.ts`).

localTime.description: Plant-local wall-clock time `HH:MM` (24 h), interpreted in the calendar timezone.

ianaTimezone.description: IANA tz database identifier (e.g. `Asia/Tehran`, `Europe/Berlin`, `Etc/GMT+3`) or `UTC`. Spec section 3.3, CAL01.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code. `XXX` is the ISO 4217 'no currency' code and marks an undecided tenant currency (VAL01 requires a decided currency before valuation is approved).

nonNegativeSeconds.description: Duration in whole seconds (spec section 3.3: durations are seconds).
